networks.label: XTX4 u_b  (2.0 M params, ncnn FP16 weights)
networks.description: Raspberry Pi 5 network. 300 epochs, full test AP 0.582 / 0.625 / 0.647 @256 / 320 / 384. Pi 5 @320 (3 threads, FP16): 11.7 ms network.

networks.label: XTX4 u_c  (3.9 M params, ncnn FP16 weights)
networks.description: Larger and more accurate variant. 300 epochs, full test AP 0.640 / 0.679 / 0.700 @256 / 320 / 384. Pi 5 @320 (3 threads, FP16): 19.9 ms network.

networks.label: XTX4 u_b  (ncnn FP32 weights - precision reference)
networks.description: Same u_b checkpoint exported with FP32 ncnn weights. Turn FP16 off for a pure FP32 ncnn run; compare with the FP16 export and with ONNX Runtime.

networks.label: XTX4 u_c  (ncnn FP32 weights - precision reference)
networks.description: Same u_c checkpoint exported with FP32 ncnn weights.

networks.label: u_b random weights (bench graph, latency only)
networks.description: Untrained graph from bench/graphs - only for latency tests, the poses are noise.

presets.name: Pi 5 deployment (u_b @320, ncnn FP16, 3 threads, NMS)
presets.description: What runs on the Raspberry Pi: u_b @320, ncnn FP16 on 3 CPU threads, detection threshold 0.15 + OKS-NMS 0.5, visibility thresholds 0.5 / 0.8.

presets.name: Best accuracy (u_c @384, NMS)
presets.description: The most accurate combination (full test AP 0.700): u_c @384, threshold 0.15 + OKS-NMS.

presets.name: Fastest (u_b @256)
presets.description: Smallest network at the smallest input: lowest latency, weakest on small / distant people.

presets.name: Raw network output (manifest decode, no NMS)
presets.description: Exactly what the one-to-one head emits with the manifest's decode values (threshold 0.25, visibility 0.5 / 0.5, no OKS-NMS). Keeps network, size and backend.

presets.name: FP32 reference (ONNX Runtime)
presets.description: Same network and size through the exported FP32 ONNX graph on ONNX Runtime - compare with ncnn FP16 by switching the backend (key b).

presets.name: ncnn pure FP32 (u_b FP32 weights, FP16 off)
presets.description: ncnn with FP32 weights and FP32 arithmetic: matches PyTorch to ~0.001 px. Shows what the FP16 deployment costs in precision and gains in speed.

presets.name: Crowd / small people (u_c @384, low threshold, NMS + IoU)
presets.description: More recall for small or distant people: u_c @384, threshold 0.10, up to 100 people, OKS-NMS with a larger scale factor plus extent-box IoU 0.5 against duplicates.

presets.name: Pyramid mode (3 views, XTX3 ablation)
presets.description: Three passes per frame (whole canvas + centre zooms 2x and 4x) merged by view priority, as XTX3 n/m/l did. About 3x slower; for comparison only.

presets.name: Debug overlay (sigma, NMS extents, labels, network input)
presets.description: Shows everything the network outputs: sigma circles, the extent boxes OKS-NMS uses, person numbers, keypoint names and the letterboxed network input.

presets.name: Clean overlay
presets.description: Only skeletons and visible keypoints, no texts.
